reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.description: Limit animations. Follow system uses your OS setting.

general.title: General
general.featuresDescription: Turn optional interface features on or off.
general.healthIndicatorsDescription: Show success rate and response time in collections.
general.codeGenPanelDescription: Show code snippets for the current request (cURL, fetch, axios, Python, Go).
general.chainExecutionDescription: Number of chain nodes the runner executes in parallel.
general.confirmCloseUnsavedTabsDescription: Show a confirmation before closing a tab with unsaved changes.

proxy.title: Network and security
proxy.sslVerificationDescription: Verify SSL certificates for HTTPS requests.
proxy.proxyUrlDescription: Send all requests through this proxy server.

clearHistory.label: Request history
clearHistory.description: Delete every entry in your request history on this device.
clearHistory.title: Clear request history?
clearHistory.dialogDescription: This permanently deletes every entry in your request history on this device. Saved requests, collections and environments are not affected. This cannot be undone.

backup.title: Data
backup.description: Export your workspace to a file or restore it from one.

export.title: Export backup
export.description: Save your workspace to a file you can restore later.
export.secretsWarning: Anyone with this file can read your secrets. Store it securely.
export.secretsOffNote: With this switch off, tokens, passwords and secret headers are left blank in the file, so you will need to enter them again after restoring.
export.secretsResponsesNote: Secret values are saved in the file as they are. Saved responses in history may also contain secrets.
export.relayThreadsNote: Conversations may contain values you shared with Relay.
export.danglingReferences: {count, plural, one {# link points to an item that is not in this backup.} other {# links point to items that are not in this backup.}}
export.danglingExplanation: A link joins one item to another, such as a chain step that calls a saved request. These links are broken because the items they point to are not selected, so they will not work after you restore. To keep them working, also include the collections, folders, requests or chains they point to.

import.title: Import backup
import.description: Restore a backup file made with Export backup.
import.dropHint: Drop a backup file here, or choose one.
import.mergeDescription: Adds what is missing and keeps everything you already have. Nothing in your workspace is overwritten or deleted.
import.replaceDescription: Deletes your current local data for every section in this file, then restores it from the file. Sections that are not in the file are left alone.
import.restoreFailed: Could not restore this backup. Nothing was changed.

replaceConfirm.title: Delete current data and restore?
replaceConfirm.description: Replace deletes the data listed below from this device first, then loads it from the backup. It cannot be reversed from here.
replaceConfirm.deleteCount: {section}: {count, plural, one {# item will be deleted} other {# items will be deleted}}

errors.invalidJson: This file is not valid JSON.
errors.invalidFile: This file is not a valid Requestr backup.
errors.foreignFile: This is not a Requestr backup. Use Import for Postman, Insomnia or OpenAPI files.
errors.newerVersion: This backup was made by a newer version of Requestr (v{n}). Update the app to restore it.
errors.unsupportedVersion: This backup version is no longer supported.
errors.damagedSection: The backup is damaged: {section} is invalid.

backup.largeBackupWarning: Large backup, restore may take a while.

summary.title: Backup restored
summary.added: {count, plural, one {# item added} other {# items added}}
summary.skipped: {count, plural, one {# identical item skipped} other {# identical items skipped}}
summary.kept: {count, plural, one {# item kept alongside your existing one} other {# items kept alongside your existing ones}}
summary.danglingReferences: {count, plural, one {# link points to an item that is missing.} other {# links point to items that are missing.}}

importCard.title: Restore a Requestr backup
importCard.description: Bring back a workspace from a backup file made with Export backup.

requestDefaults.title: Request defaults
requestDefaults.description: Base URL and headers added to every HTTP and GraphQL request.
requestDefaults.defaultHeadersDescription: Added to every request. A header set on the request itself wins.
